capabilities: Resolve search terms to place suggestions and coordinates
Reverse-resolve coordinates to the nearest named feature
Provide POI search over OpenStreetMap data
disambiguation: Not a stand-alone plugin; it only adds Photon-backed place search to the Places plugin.
extras: Not a stand-alone plugin; requires the Places plugin and its places-shared library. Usage examples are in the Places sandbox rather than the README. Makes network requests to Photon for POI and reverse search; no background tasks.
intentEvidence: Search provider for Places using Photon, with POI search over OpenStreetMap data.
problem: The Places plugin needs a search backend to turn place names into coordinates and coordinates back into named features.

relations.evidence: This is not a stand-alone plugin, to use, install along side Places.
Search provider for Places using Photon, with POI search over OpenStreetMap data.

summary: Search provider add-on for the Places plugin that uses Photon to resolve place names to coordinates and coordinates to named features.
